title: Bats
subtitle: Seeing with sound
summary: A fifth of all mammal species are bats, and most of them find their food in the dark by shouting and listening to the echoes. Each lesson opens on a real puzzle, Spallanzani's blinded bats that flew on, a moth that dives at the last moment, a cave where bats die in February, and follows the people who solved it, with live figures you can push and slowed-down calls you can hear. Branches go to the bats over a Seattle lake at dusk, and to building a detector that lets you hear them.
